verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a way for the user to disable telemetry or usage tracking that RudderStack itself collects, whether in the SDK, the open-source server, or the MCP server. The Consent Management and compliance-toolkit items describe a different capability: they help RudderStack customers capture their end users' consent. Self-hosting and data-residency options are likewise not a telemetry opt-out for the product itself.
